title: Camp Counselor
description: Location- in person Position Type-Contract,Seasonal Base Salary Range: $425.00-475.00/weekly No AI is used for screening, assessment, or selection. Holy Trinity School is a co-educational day school with students from JK to Grade 12. HTS Camps strives to offer a wide variety of safe, educational, enjoyable, and fun-filled activities for children of all ages. We encourage our campers to be enthusiastic participants and challenge each camper to be their best. In addition to high-quality instruction of each individual camp’s theme, our HTS Camp staff are passionate about teaching core values such as respect, teamwork, compassion and honour; enabling each camper to be better citizens in their community. About This Summer Camp Role: HTS has exciting summer opportunities to join our Summer Camps as a Camp Counselor. The Counselor is responsible for leading campers through the core and non-core programs and creating positive experiences for campers in a small group setting. They will also be responsible for the general safety and development, growth, and skill achievement of the participants in their group. What You Need: We are inviting candidates with the following qualifications to apply: Must have completed grade 11, and working towards completing OSSGD Previous experience working with kids within a summer day camp, or coaching, volunteering, or other related work Experience planning and leading programs for children and youth Standard First Aid and CPR ‘C’ (prior to the first day of camp) Strong interpersonal communication skills and conflict resolution skills Must have the physical ability to lead and participate in camp activities which include, but are not limited to, hiking, swimming, team building initiatives, physical games, and activities. Apply Now If you are interested in joining us at our attractive Richmond Hill campus we encourage you to apply at www.hts.on.ca Applications will be accepted until the positions are filled.  We thank all applicants for their interest however we will only contact those selected for an interview. This summer, students ages 4–14 can train, play, and grow in a high-energy camp powered by TAC Sports Camps. Using TAC’s comprehensive 5-Star Tennis Development System, campers are grouped by age and skill level to ensure optimal learning and lots of fun. Each week features progressive lesson plans that build skills day by day, combining on-court drills, rally games, and friendly competitions. Younger and newer players benefit from modified equipment (mini nets and low-compression balls) so they can experience success early, while more advanced players follow clear development pathways from beginner to high-performance levels. Holy Trinity School is committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible, and equitable workplace where every individual has the opportunity to contribute, and succeed. We welcome applications from racialized persons/persons of colour, women, Indigenous people, persons with disabilities, 2SLGBTQ+  persons, and others who may contribute to the further diversification of ideas. HTS is committed to providing an inclusive and barrier-free recruitment process. If you require accommodation, please contact the People and Culture department by email to: peopleandculture@hts.on.ca. We will work with you to understand your needs and provide appropriate accommodation so you can participate fully in the recruitment process. All accommodation requests will be handled confidentially.

jobposting.description:
Location- in person

Position Type-Contract,Seasonal

Base Salary Range: $425.00-475.00/weekly

No AI is used for screening, assessment, or selection.


Holy Trinity School is a co-educational day school with students from JK to Grade 12.  HTS Camps strives to offer a wide variety of safe, educational, enjoyable, and fun-filled activities for children of all ages.


We encourage our campers to be enthusiastic participants and challenge each camper to be their best. In addition to high-quality instruction of each individual camp’s theme, our HTS Camp staff are passionate about teaching core values such as respect, teamwork, compassion and honour; enabling each camper to be better citizens in their community.


About This Summer Camp Role:

HTS has exciting summer opportunities to join our Summer Camps as a Camp Counselor. 


The Counselor is responsible for leading campers through the core and non-core programs and creating positive experiences for campers in a small group setting. They will also be responsible for the general safety and development, growth, and skill achievement of the participants in their group.


What You Need:

We are inviting candidates with the following qualifications to apply:


  • Must have completed grade 11, and working towards completing OSSGD
  • Previous experience working with kids within a summer day camp, or coaching, volunteering, or other related work
  • Experience planning and leading programs for children and youth
  • Standard First Aid and CPR ‘C’ (prior to the first day of camp)
  • Strong interpersonal communication skills and conflict resolution skills
  • Must have the physical ability to lead and participate in camp activities which include, but are not limited to, hiking, swimming, team building initiatives, physical games, and activities.


Apply Now

If you are interested in joining us at our attractive Richmond Hill campus we encourage you to apply at www.hts.on.ca

Applications will be accepted until the positions are filled.  We thank all applicants for their interest however we will only contact those selected for an interview.  


This summer, students ages 4–14 can train, play, and grow in a high-energy camp powered by TAC Sports Camps. Using TAC’s comprehensive 5-Star Tennis Development System, campers are grouped by age and skill level to ensure optimal learning and lots of fun. Each week features progressive lesson plans that build skills day by day, combining on-court drills, rally games, and friendly competitions. Younger and newer players benefit from modified equipment (mini nets and low-compression balls) so they can experience success early, while more advanced players follow clear development pathways from beginner to high-performance levels.

We welcome applications from racialized persons/persons of colour, women, Indigenous people, persons with disabilities, 2SLGBTQ+  persons, and others who may contribute to the further diversification of ideas.

HTS is committed to providing an inclusive and barrier-free recruitment process. If you require accommodation, please contact the People and Culture department by email to: peopleandculture@hts.on.ca. We will work with you to understand your needs and provide appropriate accommodation so you can participate fully in the recruitment process. All accommodation requests will be handled confidentially.
